'''Invisible Knight''' is a [[Draco-Titan]] who appears as an invisible man wearing pieces of a knight's suit of armor. In addition to his armor, he bears a shield and a sword.

== History ==
Invisible Knight was once encountered by [[Dante Vale]]. {{Source|TCG:SAS-084|SAS-084}}

== Abilities ==
Invisible Knight gets a strategic advantage in battle due to be its appearance of a display of armor. It is also known to have an amazing grasp of tactics. {{Source|TCG:SAS-084|SAS-084}}
